scope: Interrupted current-source route audit, preserved before repairing Show more rebuilding all existing previews. This is 214/520 components and 1712/4160 cases, not full-catalog acceptance.

modes: trusted warm caption input with actual Back-scroll restoration

context.stageTheme: Stage uses each component default metadata. The theme setting in this cold-route profiler changes the shell through intrx-theme localStorage; it is not a matrix of independent Stage overrides.
context.collection: One fresh Chrome process per component through the batch wrapper; one empty browser context per recorded sample. No performance sample or outlier is discarded. Local network has no emulated latency; OS caches and other host work remain uncontrolled.
context.paint: Heading keeps document.fonts.ready plus two animation frames; Stage keeps two frames after actual full boot. Assets-ready remains separate. First trace Paint does not prove full photographic readiness.
limits: This collection does not establish CPU4 frame-rate acceptance, Lighthouse, reduced-motion behavior, 375px/360px typography or all-state accessibility.
A completed route record with a timing miss is functional coverage, not a 300ms acceptance pass.
Raw trace browser work overlapping delayed frame callbacks is diagnostic evidence; overlap alone does not establish causality.
390px is viewport-only: no mobile-device, touch, device-scale or network emulation is enabled in this profiler.
context.preservedDiagnostic: The initial warm trace analysis used the wrong interval before the trusted input. Its JSON/log are retained as diagnostic-analysis-wrong-warm-window.*; corrected analysis is bound to the input-to-paint interval.
context.assetsReadyDefinition: After full boot, wait two animation frames, document.fonts.ready, decode() for the Stage DOM img elements queried at that point, then two further frames. This does not cover CSS background images, GPU textures, later inserted images or compositor presentation.

interruption.reason: Show more destroys and recreates all prior previews on every batch. Preserve this partial collection before fixing incremental append and existing state/runtime continuity.
interruption.scope: Interrupted source-stable route matrix; not full-catalog acceptance. All completed reports, traces and raw timing misses remain retained.

finding.behavior: Show more increases the limit and calls render(), which destroys the existing LiveTiles manager and replaces every grid child before recreating all visible items.
finding.evidence: Source inspection plus saved collection timings: lenis-smooth-scroll took 8.3s with 1.8s of warm preparation; svg-squiggle-underline took 23.8s with 9.3s of preparation; map-city-tiles took 40.5s with 18.2s of preparation. These observations do not attribute all overhead to one operation.
finding.next: Reproduce existing preview/runtime/state replacement, append only the next batch, verify unchanged artwork/lifecycle/Back state, then run the complete route matrix on the corrected source.

remaining: All 520 routes remain the target. Recorded startup timing misses, CPU4 frame rates, Lighthouse and final accessibility/manual review remain open.
